description: Generate a complete MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, or GPL-3.0 license file with your name and year filled in.

faqs.a: MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, and GPL-3.0 — each emitted as the complete license text, ready to save as LICENSE.
GPL-3.0 is a strong copyleft license: distributing the program requires sharing source under the same license. This tool is not legal advice — check with a lawyer for real projects.
faqs.q: Should I pick GPL-3.0 for my project?

faqs.a: Yes — your name, the year, and the project name are substituted into the copyright lines automatically.
Everything is generated locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Pick a license and enter your name and year.
Click Generate — copy the text or download it as LICENSE.
title: License Generator
